payload.reason: The evidence provides specific modifications made to post-trained BERT, including the addition of adversarial examples and adjustments in training epochs and dropout values to enhance performance in aspect extraction and sentiment classification tasks.

claims.text: Post-trained BERT (BERT-PT) incorporates adversarial examples to improve performance on aspect extraction and aspect sentiment classification tasks.
The model is initialized with the uncased version of BERT_BASE and experiments with different training epochs and dropout values to optimize performance.
Adversarial training has been shown to improve the performance of BERT-PT in both aspect extraction and aspect sentiment classification tasks.
The modifications include not changing the [CLS] token during adversarial example creation, focusing on altering the input sentence's word vectors instead.
